channel.title: Pier & Point · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Building 12 Plaza and Market Square (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the…
item.description: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 3 within approximately 25 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2042; 2042 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 25 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: The 2042 date was removed
item.description: The 2042 date was removed. It was the final-phase outside date for the whole project, which does not apply to this Phase 1 park. The Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) ties the plaza's completion to one year after the temporary certificates of occupancy for adjacent buildings, which have not been reported, so no calendar date can be given. Source: Port of San Francisco, Item 9B: Pier 70 Mixed-Use Project approvals, Sep 22, 2017 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Item 11A: Pier 70 28-Acre Site Project update, Aug 7, 2026 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an…
item.description: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: The plaza's layout is now described as the D4D…
item.description: The plaza's layout is now described as the D4D gives it (Market Square north of Building 12, the entry plaza south, the Maryland Street Platform on its east side), and the map notes no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor or explain the acreage gap as a fact. The 2042 completion milestone is now a soft placeholder (the 2017 Phase 3 outside date, tolled by down market delay) rather than a forecast, and the Building 15 move is dated to the 2018-2020 window the Port gives. Image credits no longer name design firms the figure does not credit or say 'adopted 2017', and Phase 1 park membership is cited to Port Item 9B. Source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, Pier 70 Project Update, 2025-06 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/Pier%2070%20Update%20-%20June%202025%20v3.pdf).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, Pier 70 Project Update, 2025-06 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/Pier%2070%20Update%20-%20June%202025%20v3.pdf)

item.title: Added · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Building 12 Plaza and Market Square added, filling…
item.description: Building 12 Plaza and Market Square added, filling its block between Buildings 2, D and 12. The event date is the Planning Commission's Aug 24, 2017 approval of the Pier 70 D4D that defines the space (Resolution 19980). Source: Pier 70 D4D, Figure 6.4.2; Port Item 9B (Sep 22, 2017).

item.title: Planned · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Port reports that although Phase 1… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and Building 12's rehabilitation are complete, construction of the balance of Phase 1, 'largely comprised of the Phase 1 parks and open space,' will be built 'on a schedule that coincides with the delivery of adjacent vertical development,' which 'has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases, construction-cost escalation and higher financing costs (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Milestone · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Building 15 lifted and moved from its… (~2019)
item.description: Building 15 lifted and moved from its temporary location to its permanent location over the newly built 22nd Street during Phase 1 infrastructure work. The Port's June 2025 deck lists this under 'Phase 1 Infrastructure Completed - 2018 - 2020' without a year, and the Port's Aug 2026 report says 22nd Street surface improvements began in March 2019, so a move over the 'newly built' street before 2019 is unlikely; the year shown is the earliest consistent with both and is approximate (~2019). Source: Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, 2025-06.
item.source: Port of San Francisco / Brookfield Properties, 2025-06

item.title: Milestone · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Port Commission approves the Pier… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Pier 70 project (Item 12B: 'On September 26, 2017, the Port Commission approved a mixed-use development project'). DDA terms as proposed in the Sep 22, 2017 staff report (Item 9B): parks completed 12-18 months after adjacent buildings, with Port Commission approval of the parks' schematic design (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2020-02-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2020-02-11
